name: email-plugin-deps
description: Vendored runtime dependencies for the email plugin's IMAP inbound listener — see services/imap-service.js. Committed node_modules, not gitignored: the plugin installer copies this directory verbatim with no npm-install step, so the resolved dependency tree must already exist on disk for Node's module resolution to find it. DO NOT add a top-level "type" field to this file: the plugin's pre-existing send-path files (hooks/notify-complete.js, tools/send-email.js) are ESM and rely on this package.json having no "type" field so Node's per-file syntax detection can tell CJS/ESM apart — adding "type":"commonjs" would break those files.
